clock.title: Clock
clock.pending: {{action}} tapped at {{time}}. It is saved on this phone and has not reached the server yet.
clock.retryNote: Tap the red button to send it again. It is recorded only once, even if an earlier try got through.
clock.offline: You are offline. Your tap is kept on this phone until it can be sent.
clock.conflict: Your status had already changed, so this tap was not needed. Your timeline is up to date now.
clock.refused: The server did not accept this punch. Tell HR if it keeps happening.
